resources.string: OnePlus engineering checks, RPMB and SOTER
Hardware key status is unknown. This screen only checks which related services Android lists.

On compatible OnePlus firmware, dial *#899# and record the exact RPMB and SOTER results. Turn off external TEE modules and the built-in TEE engine in Settings, then reboot and repeat the same checks. If the error persists, provide the model, system build and results to OnePlus support for a provisioning check. Keep persist, secure storage and RPMB intact.
